func sumOne(): Int64 {
    var n = 1
    var s = 0
    while (1 <= n) {
        s = s + 1
        n = n - 1
    }
    s
}

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

func sumOne(): Int64 {
    var n = 1
    var s = 0
    while (1 <= n) {
        s = s + 1
        n = n - 1
    }
    s
}

func multiply(a: Int64, b: Int64): Int64 {
    a * b
}

func divide(a: Int64, b: Int64): Int64 {
    a / b
}

main(): Unit {
    sumOne()
}

struct Cell {

func bump(): Int64 {
    var p = Cell(0)

    p.x
}

func bumpKeep(): Int64 {
    let r = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }

    unsafe { r.read() }
}

main(): Unit {

// Generated by tools/extraction/rocq/emit_cj.v from the CJR core terms.

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

func cell(): Unit {
    let p = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    unsafe { p.write(7) }
    unsafe { p.read() }
    unsafe { free(CPointer<Unit>(p)) }
}

main(): Unit {
    cell()
}

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

struct VTable {
    public var inc: (Counter) -> Unit
    public init(inc: (Counter) -> Unit) {
        this.inc = inc
    }
}

class Counter {
    public var value: Int64
    public init(value: Int64) {
        this.value = value
    }
}

func inc(self: Counter): Unit {
    self.value = self.value + 1
}

func run(): Int64 {
    let box = VTable(inc)
    let o = Counter(0)
    box.inc(o)
    o.value
}

main(): Unit {
    run()
}

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

func swap(l1: CPointer<Int64>, l2: CPointer<Int64>): Unit {
    let t = unsafe { l1.read() }
    unsafe { l1.write(unsafe { l2.read() }) }
    unsafe { l2.write(t) }
}

main(): Unit {
    let l1 = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    let l2 = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    unsafe { l1.write(1) }
    unsafe { l2.write(2) }
    swap(l1, l2)
}

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

func sumAt(p: CPointer<Int64>): Int64 {
    var i = 0
    var s = 0
    while (i <= 0) {
        s = s + unsafe { (p + i).read() }
        i = i + 1
    }
    s
}

main(): Unit {
    let p = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    unsafe { p.write(4) }
    sumAt(p)
}

foreign func calloc(count: UIntNative, size: UIntNative): CPointer<Unit>
foreign func free(ptr: CPointer<Unit>): Unit

func write(x: CPointer<Int64>): Unit {
    unsafe { x.write(9) }
}

func frameCall(p: CPointer<Int64>, q: CPointer<Int64>): Int64 {
    write(p)
    unsafe { q.read() }
}

main(): Unit {
    let p = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    let q = unsafe { CPointer<Int64>(calloc(UIntNative(1), UIntNative(8))) }
    unsafe { q.write(3) }
    frameCall(p, q)
}

Definition p_frame_call :=
  Prog [] []
    [Fn "write" None (Some "x") write_body [t_ptr] "Unit";
     Fn "frameCall" None (Some "args") frame_body [t_ptr; t_ptr] t_int]
    (Let (Some "p") (Alloc (int 1))
      (Let (Some "q") (Alloc (int 1))
        (Seq (Store (Var "q") (int 3))
          (App (Rec None (Some "args") frame_body)
            (Struct [] [Var "p"; Var "q"]))))).
